name: glm-5.3-prime
description: GLM-5.3-Prime is the high-speed variant of GLM-5.3, with across-the-board improvements in coding and agentic capabilities, reaching SOTA performance among open-source models. It improves by 50% over the previous generation on internal coding benchmarks and can deliver production-grade results end to end. The model also demonstrates emergent cybersecurity capabilities, achieving the current best result on the CyberGym vulnerability discovery benchmark. It supports a 1M-token context window, up to 128K output tokens, and three levels of deep reasoning for complex, long-horizon tasks.
zhDescription: GLM-5.3-Prime 是 GLM-5.3 的高速版本，编程与智能体能力全面进阶，达开源模型 SOTA 水平，内部编程基准较上代提升 50%，可端到端交付生产级成果。涌现网络安全能力，漏洞发现基准 CyberGym 创当前最佳。支持 1M 上下文、128K 输出与三档深度思考，胜任长程复杂任务。
